$comment: Rulebook SP-1990 for one-, two-, and three-head masts (Corporal and Christopher). Sources: tools/spcoast.layout.json (TypeD searchlight heads present STOP, APPROACH, ADVANCE_APPROACH, CLEAR and DARK; Corporal 830WAB/830EAB have two heads, Christopher 814EABC has three, others one), docs/Walkthrough.md step 7 (two-head APPROACH = Yellow over Red), and FieldUnit SignalAspectPolicy::sp1985 / defaultRoute (third head RED for normal and primary-diverging routes). One head: STOP red, APPROACH yellow, ADVANCE_APPROACH flashing yellow, CLEAR green. Two heads: top head (head.A) carries the one-head aspect over a red head.B; DIVERGING_APPROACH red over yellow and DIVERGING_CLEAR red over green. Three heads: the two-head aspect over a red head.C. Not covered (a mast shows and reports STOP): RESTRICTING, DIVERGING_RESTRICTING, APPROACH_MEDIUM, and DIVERGING_* on one head.
